const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Camera-guided controller for the one-shot Meta-World handle-pull episode.
+
+The client is deliberately kept on vision, the documented target point, and
+robot proprioception.  Run with ``python -i /app/output/gen.py`` and advance
+through ``approach_hover()``, ``descend()``, ``close_gripper()``, then
+``lift()`` while inspecting the camera images between stages.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+RUNS = OUT / "episode"
+CAMERAS = ["left", "right", "topview", "front"]
+
+
+class HandlePull:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.robot = Robot()
+        self.spec = self.robot.spec()
+        self.dt = float(self.spec["control_dt"])
+        self.initial = self.robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True)
+        self.target = np.asarray(self.initial.meta["task"]["target_pos"], dtype=float)
+        self.obs = self.initial
+        self.calls = 0
+        RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        self.save_obs("initial", self.initial)
+        self._write_status()
+        print("target_pos:", self.target)
+        print("proprio:", self.proprio())
+        print("time_left_s:", self.obs.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+
+    def proprio(self):
+        return np.asarray(self.obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+
+    def layout(self):
+        return self.obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+
+    def value(self, name):
+        return self.proprio()[self.layout().index(name)]
+
+    def _write_status(self):
+        (RUNS / "status.json").write_text(json.dumps({
+            "target_pos": self.target.tolist(),
+            "meta": self.obs.meta,
+            "proprio": self.proprio().tolist(),
+        }, indent=2))
+
+    def save_obs(self, tag, obs):
+        path = RUNS / tag
+        path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        for cam, img in obs.last.items():
+            from PIL import Image
+            Image.fromarray(img).save(path / f"{cam}.png")
+        for cam, dep in obs.depth.items():
+            np.save(path / f"{cam}_depth.npy", dep)
+        (path / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+
+    def observe(self, tag="check"):
+        self.obs = self.robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True)
+        self.calls += 1
+        self.save_obs(f"{tag}_{self.calls:03d}", self.obs)
+        self._write_status()
+        print("observed", tag, "tcp", self.proprio()[:3], "mocap", self.proprio()[4:7],
+              "opening", self.proprio()[3], "time_left_s", self.obs.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+        return self.obs
+
+    def _submit_rows(self, rows, tag):
+        rows = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float64)
+        res = self.robot.submit("ee_delta", rows, dt=self.dt, interpolate="hold",
+                                cameras=CAMERAS, video="frames", include_depth=True,
+                                note=tag)
+        self.calls += 1
+        (RUNS / "actions.jsonl").open("a").write(json.dumps({
+            "tag": tag, "dt": self.dt, "actions": rows.tolist(),
+            "control_steps": res.meta.get("control_steps"),
+            "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+        }) + "\n")
+        # Pull a fresh, zero-time observation for the current proprioception and
+        # calibrated RGB/depth; the submitted result itself is also preserved.
+        self.save_obs(f"{tag}_{self.calls:03d}", res)
+        self.obs = self.robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True)
+        self._write_status()
+        p = self.proprio()
+        print(tag, "tcp", np.round(p[:3], 4), "mocap", np.round(p[4:7], 4),
+              "opening", round(float(p[3]), 3), "steps", res.meta.get("control_steps"),
+              "left", round(float(self.obs.meta.get("time_left_s", -1)), 1))
+        if res.done:
+            print("episode done:", res.meta.get("reason"))
+        return res
+
+    def move_tcp(self, goal, grip=-1.0, max_action=0.22, batch_rows=20, tag="move"):
+        """Move the fingertip midpoint to a world-frame waypoint in small increments."""
+        goal = np.asarray(goal, dtype=float)
+        p = self.proprio()
+        tcp = p[:3]
+        mocap = p[4:7]
+        offset = mocap - tcp
+        mocap_goal = goal + offset
+        delta = mocap_goal - mocap
+        n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta)) / (0.01 * max_action))))
+        one = np.r_[delta / n / 0.01, float(grip)]
+        if np.max(np.abs(one[:3])) > 1.00001:
+            raise ValueError("increment exceeds native action limits")
+        print(tag, "tcp_goal", goal, "mocap_goal", np.round(mocap_goal, 4),
+              "steps", n, "per_step", np.round(one, 3))
+        sent = 0
+        while sent < n:
+            k = min(batch_rows, n - sent)
+            self._submit_rows(np.repeat(one[None, :], k, axis=0), f"{tag}_{sent:03d}")
+            sent += k
+        return self.obs
+
+    def approach_hover(self):
+        # The calibrated top view places the visible red handle on target x/y.
+        # Keep the fingertip midpoint 12 cm above its low crossbar while moving in.
+        return self.move_tcp([self.target[0], self.target[1], 0.19],
+                             grip=-1.0, tag="hover")
+
+    def descend(self):
+        # Side-camera depth places the handle crossbar about 6 cm above the table.
+        # Open fingertips descend to its center, with the hand target 5 cm above tcp.
+        return self.move_tcp([self.target[0], self.target[1], 0.062],
+                             grip=-1.0, max_action=0.14, tag="descend")
+
+    def close_gripper(self, rows=32):
+        action = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0])
+        return self._submit_rows(np.repeat(action[None, :], rows, axis=0), "close")
+
+    def lift(self, goal_z=None):
+        # The task target is about 10 cm above the observed initial crossbar.
+        # Moving tcp to target z keeps the gripped handle at its upward goal.
+        if goal_z is None:
+            goal_z = float(self.target[2])
+        p = self.proprio()
+        return self.move_tcp([self.target[0], self.target[1], goal_z],
+                             grip=1.0, max_action=0.12, tag="lift")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    # Interactive inspection between stages is intentional for this one-shot task.
+    c = HandlePull()
*** End Patch";
